# Pragnya

> AI product development and software agency. We build production-grade web apps, AI systems, and resilient architecture for founders and teams.

## Overview

Pragnya partners with founders and teams to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems, modern web applications, and resilient architecture — without the technical debt that slows you down.

## Products

- [Edward](https://github.com/pragnya-works/edward): An agentic web app builder we built in-house. Founders describe a product in chat, Edward plans and generates the app in a sandbox, and the result can be previewed before syncing to GitHub.
- [Edward demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zIBuOmr92_s): Video walkthrough of Edward building an app.
